idea.h: Leverage the $166 billion tariff refund opportunity to optimize working capital for import-dependent retailers.
idea.why: Analyze which specific import categories will benefit most from the universal refunds and adjust stock levels accordingly. Fortune reports that American importers are one step closer to receiving massive refunds, creating a window to reduce cash flow constraints and potentially lower consumer prices.
